name: 1c_cycling
description: Repeated 1C cycles: 1C discharge to 3.0 V, rest, 1C CC-CV charge to 4.2 V, rest
comment: Same settings as 1c_discharge_charge_cycle, repeated. Start from a full cell (as after any of the discharge/charge cycles), so every discharge runs full to 3.0 V and is a capacity measurement; the run ends charged. Change 'repeat' for more or fewer cycles. max_duration_s is a safety ceiling per phase, not for the whole run. No cell is named: pick it when launching.
